A SYNTHETIC policy-exercise catalog, NOT the live server contract: it deliberately spreads the Studio family across several `view` values (`setup`, `lifecycle`, `publication`) so the family, view, and allowlist decision paths can be driven independently, and it carries lifecycle verbs a real honua-server does not advertise yet. The shipped honua-server contract is pinned separately by `tools-list.candidate-setup.page{1,2}.v1.json`, where every classified descriptor carries view `setup`.
